questionName: Conflicting Document Information Extraction & Contradiction Resolution
inputPrompt:
Read the following technical report excerpts and produce: 1) Key agreed metrics, 2) Explicit contradictions between Section A and Section B, 3) Reconciliation recommendation.

[SECTION A: INFRASTRUCTURE REPORT 2026-Q1]
The primary voice inference cluster operates 64 NVIDIA H100 instances in Mumbai (ap-south-1). Average Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) across 1.2M turns was measured at 184ms with p99 at 412ms. Overall cluster utilization remained at 76%. Monthly infrastructure expenditure totaled $48,200 with zero downtime reported.

[SECTION B: INCIDENT RETROSPECTIVE 2026-Q1]
On February 14, 2026, the ap-south-1 voice inference cluster suffered an 82-minute outage caused by a routing table misconfiguration during firmware updates. During peak hours, average TTFT spiked to 620ms across 48 active H100 instances, leading to 14,200 dropped voice sessions. Total operational costs for the quarter, including incident remediation and SLAs penalties, rose to $61,500. Average utilization was capped at 52% due to thermal throttling.

[SECTION C: ARCHITECTURAL REVIEW]
The team recommends migrating the fallback model to a quantized 8-bit checkpoint to reduce memory footprint by 35% and mitigate thermal throttling.
expectedBehavior: Identifies agreed metrics (Mumbai ap-south-1, H100 cluster), flags direct contradictions (Zero downtime in Sec A vs 82-min outage in Sec B; 64 instances vs 48 instances; 184ms TTFT vs 620ms; $48.2k vs $61.5k; 76% vs 52% utilization), and produces a structured reconciliation.

execution.finalAnswer: Section A reports zero downtime and forty-eight thousand dollars in expenses, whereas Section B logs an eighty-two-minute outage and sixty-one thousand five hundred dollars in costs. To reconcile these, the operational metrics in Section A should be updated to reflect the incident downtime, and costs adjusted to include remediation penalties.
